doc.brief: An event controller to initiate Drag-And-Drop operations.

drag_cancel.brief: Cancels a currently ongoing drag operation.
drag_cancel.md: Cancels a currently ongoing drag operation.

get_actions.brief: Gets the actions that are currently set on the `GtkDragSource`.
get_actions.md: Gets the actions that are currently set on the `GtkDragSource`.

get_content.brief: Gets the current content provider of a `GtkDragSource`.
get_content.md: Gets the current content provider of a `GtkDragSource`.

get_drag.brief: Returns the underlying `GdkDrag` object for an ongoing drag.
get_drag.md: Returns the underlying `GdkDrag` object for an ongoing drag.

set_actions.md:
Sets the actions on the `GtkDragSource`.

During a DND operation, the actions are offered to potential
drop targets. If `actions` include %GDK_ACTION_MOVE, you need
to listen to the [`DragSource::drag-end`](xref:gtk:Gtk.DragSource#event:drag-end) signal and
handle `delete_data` being `TRUE`.

This function can be called before a drag is started,
or in a handler for the [`DragSource::prepare`](xref:gtk:Gtk.DragSource#event:prepare) signal.

set_content.brief: Sets a content provider on a `GtkDragSource`.
set_content.md:
Sets a content provider on a `GtkDragSource`.

When the data is requested in the cause of a DND operation,
it will be obtained from the content provider.

This function can be called before a drag is started,
or in a handler for the [`DragSource::prepare`](xref:gtk:Gtk.DragSource#event:prepare) signal.

You may consider setting the content provider back to
`NULL` in a [`DragSource::drag-end`](xref:gtk:Gtk.DragSource#event:drag-end) signal handler.

set_icon.brief: Sets a paintable to use as icon during DND operations.
set_icon.md:
Sets a paintable to use as icon during DND operations.

The hotspot coordinates determine the point on the icon
that gets aligned with the hotspot of the cursor.

If `paintable` is `NULL`, a default icon is used.

This function can be called before a drag is started, or in
a [`DragSource::prepare`](xref:gtk:Gtk.DragSource#event:prepare) or
[`DragSource::drag-begin`](xref:gtk:Gtk.DragSource#event:drag-begin) signal handler.

actions.brief: The actions that are supported by drag operations from the source.
actions.md:
The actions that are supported by drag operations from the source.

Note that you must handle the [`DragSource::drag-end`](xref:gtk:Gtk.DragSource#event:drag-end) signal
if the actions include %GDK_ACTION_MOVE.

content.brief: The data that is offered by drag operations from this source.
content.md: The data that is offered by drag operations from this source.

drag-begin.brief: Emitted on the drag source when a drag is started.
drag-begin.md:
Emitted on the drag source when a drag is started.

It can be used to e.g. set a custom drag icon with
[`DragSource.set_icon()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.DragSource#method:set_icon).

drag-cancel.brief: Emitted on the drag source when a drag has failed.
drag-cancel.md:
Emitted on the drag source when a drag has failed.

The signal handler may handle a failed drag operation based on
the type of error. It should return `TRUE` if the failure has been handled
and the default "drag operation failed" animation should not be shown.

drag-end.brief: Emitted on the drag source when a drag is finished.
drag-end.md:
Emitted on the drag source when a drag is finished.

A typical reason to connect to this signal is to undo
things done in [`DragSource::prepare`](xref:gtk:Gtk.DragSource#event:prepare) or
[`DragSource::drag-begin`](xref:gtk:Gtk.DragSource#event:drag-begin) handlers.

prepare.brief: Emitted when a drag is about to be initiated.
prepare.md:
Emitted when a drag is about to be initiated.

It returns the `GdkContentProvider` to use for the drag that is about
to start. The default handler for this signal returns the value of
the [`DragSource:content`](xref:gtk:Gtk.DragSource#property:content) property, so if you set up that
property ahead of time, you don't need to connect to this signal.
